prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production hero artwork for an exceptionally refined Apple-inspired personal portfolio website, not a UI mockup. Create one stunning photorealistic three-dimensional sculpture made from a single broad, thin, folded ribbon of perfectly clear optical glass. The ribbon sweeps diagonally upward in a fluid open serpentine fold with two beautifully rolled bends, tapering open ends, architectural precision and balanced negative space. It must NOT form a closed ring, torus, donut, toilet seat, bean, sphere, tube or recognizable letter. Physically accurate glass thickness, precision softly beveled edges, extremely crisp studio strip-light reflections, internal refraction, beautiful overlapping transparent planes and subtle prismatic dispersion. Mostly colorless clear glass with restrained icy cobalt blue, silver and pale lavender light caught only at the edges and overlaps. Dark studio flags define thin polished edges; broad faces stay transparent and luminous. Museum-quality luxury product campaign photography / exceptional high-end CGI, realistic material rather than a cartoon or smooth gradient. One very small secondary clear water droplet may hover nearby. Isolated on a genuinely transparent alpha background, no floor, horizon, opaque backdrop, text, logo, watermark, frame or interface. Entire sculpture fully visible, centered, occupying about 80 percent of a high-resolution square canvas. Light, expensive, restrained and sculptural. Deliver a clean transparent cutout.
